find: the Court announced the four-part intermediate-scrutiny test for restrictions on truthful commercial speech about lawful activity: a substantial interest, direct advancement, and a restriction no more extensive than necessary
replace: the Court announced a four-part test: whether the speech concerns lawful activity and is not misleading, whether the government asserts a substantial interest, whether the restriction directly advances it, and whether the restriction is no more extensive than necessary
reason: The protected status of the speech is the first prong of the test. The original lists only the three governmental showings after that threshold.
